segments.t: Ecstatic after his phone call from Moscow, Governor Viktor Stepanovich hurries to share the grand news with his loyal aide Stepanych. Visions of wealth and influence fill his mind as he prepares to collect the funds. Let's listen in Russian first.
Степаныч, я скоро стану федеральным министром!
Такого подарка даже я не ожидал.
Я от всей души поздравляю тебя.
Теперь мы решим абсолютно все проблемы.
Let's examine the dialogue line by line. Notice the expressions used to celebrate major promotions and discuss lucrative official positions.
Степаныч, я скоро стану федеральным министром!
'Stepanych, I will soon become a federal minister!' Joyful declaration with temporal adverb, future copular verb, and 'with'-form title.
'What ministry specifically will you head?' Question word phrase with second person future action verb.
'The ministry of fisheries of the whole country!' Exclamatory noun phrase governing two successive 'of'-form specifications.
'Well look at that, real good luck!' Expressive conversational idiom of admiration followed by descriptive subject-form noun phrase.
Такого подарка даже я не ожидал.
'Even I did not expect such a gift.' Emphatic particle with negative past action verb governing descriptive 'of'-form object.
Я от всей души поздравляю тебя.
'I congratulate you from all my heart.' Idiomatic location expression of sincerity with action verb and object pronoun.
'This is a real gold mine after all!' Emphatic particle with descriptive metaphorical descriptive phrase phrase.
'Yes, this opens huge opportunities.' Affirmative particle with third person singular present action verb and object-form object.
Теперь мы решим абсолютно все проблемы.
'Now we will solve absolutely all problems.' Temporal adverb with first person plural future verb and intensified direct object.
'First one must finish an important matter.' Temporal adverb with modal descriptive word and single-action form governing object-form.
'Are we going right now?' Present tense verb of motion with temporal adverbial phrase.
'Yes, let's go to the residence immediately.' command of motion with manner adverb and location destination.
'Where exactly are we heading right now?' Question word directional phrase with present self-action verb form of motion.

'It is time to make our move before influential people.' Descriptive word with self-action verb form basic verb form and location 'with'-form phrase. Now let's listen to the governor's excited conversation with Stepanych once again.
